Hymn 62: All Creatures of Our God and King
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Geistliche Kirchengesänge
Lyricist/Text Author: Francis of Assisi
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 62 titled "All Creatures of Our God and King" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Geistliche Kirchengesänge and the lyrics were written by Francis of Assisi.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
